# Sha512

An incremental SHA-512, SHA-384, SHA-512/224 or SHA-512/256.

```rux
pub struct Sha512 {
    // private fields
}
```

Structural `Copy`; copying takes an independent snapshot of the digest state.

<h3 id="finish"><code>Finish</code></h3>

```rux
pub func Finish(self: &var Sha512, into: var char8[..])
```

Writes the digest into `into`.
The padding carries a hundred and twenty eight bit length, so the final block needs seventeen free bytes
rather than nine; a block with fewer takes a whole further block.

| Name   | Type            | Description         |
| ------ | --------------- | ------------------- |
| `into` | `var char8[..]` | receives the output |

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Sha512.rux#L220)

<h3 id="digest-length"><code>DigestLength</code></h3>

```rux
pub func DigestLength(self: &Sha512) -> uint
```

Sixty-four, forty-eight, thirty-two or twenty-eight bytes, depending on which variant this is.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Crypto/Src/Sha512.rux#L265)

<h3 id="block-length"><code>BlockLength</code></h3>

```rux
pub func BlockLength(self: &Sha512) -> uint
```

A hundred and twenty eight bytes, for every variant.
